in_sanskrit.name: पुष्प्रज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who brings or gives fruits of love or prosperity. Pushp means flower or fruit and raj means king or one who rules.

in_marathi.name: Pushpraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Flowers
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pushpraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pushp means 'flowers' and Raja means 'king' or 'lord'. Thus, the name Pushpraj can be translated as 'Lord of Flowers'.

in_bengali.name: Pushpraj
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Flowers
in_bengali.long_meaning: Pushpraj একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Pushp means 'flowers' and Raja means 'king' or 'lord'. Thus, the name Pushpraj can be translated as 'Lord of Flowers'.
